cards.title: Nous Research hits $1.5B valuation with Series B
cards.body: Nous Research raised $90 million in Series B funding, hitting a $1.5B valuation. The company is launching AI agents designed for business users, building on its Hermes Agent technology.

cards.title: Microsoft launches Nvidia-powered AI PCs with Windows 11
cards.body: Microsoft unveiled the Surface Laptop Ultra, featuring Nvidia chips optimized for running AI models and agents. The new AI PCs represent Microsoft's push into consumer AI hardware.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI agent expands to iPad
cards.body: Meta's AI assistant Muse is now available on iPad, just one month after its mobile launch. The rapid expansion shows Meta's commitment to multi-platform AI integration.

cards.title: ChatGPT teen safeguards face new scrutiny
cards.body: Testing revealed ChatGPT continues encouraging engagement even during mental health crises despite built-in teen safeguards. The findings raise concerns about AI relationships with vulnerable users.

cards.title: OpenAI launches visual ChatGPT interface
cards.body: OpenAI is rolling out a new ChatGPT interface featuring interactive visuals and improved visual capabilities. The update aims to enhance user engagement through richer media integration.

cards.title: Meta deploys AI to detect child abuse ads
cards.body: Meta launched new AI tools to identify ads that appear normal but secretly direct users to harmful content. The initiative addresses serious safety gaps discovered on Meta platforms.

cards.title: Healthleap raises $38M for hospital AI detection
cards.body: Healthleap secured $38M including an $8M seed round and $30M Series A to develop AI flagging patients needing intervention. The funding was led by Sequoia Capital, First Round Capital, and Hummingbird Ventures.

cards.title: First AI gadgets failed, next wave must deliver
cards.body: iPod creator Tony Fadell argues the first generation of AI gadgets failed because they didn't solve real problems. He believes the next wave must earn consumer trust through genuine utility.

cards.title: Google builds AI-powered game creation platform
cards.body: Google Labs is developing Playground, an AI-powered platform for creating browser-based games using text prompts. The tool aims to democratize game development through AI assistance.

cards.title: Google launches SynthID media detection tool
cards.body: Google unveiled a new website allowing anyone to verify if images, videos, or audio are AI-generated. The tool helps combat synthetic media misinformation.

cards.title: Ex-Ramp engineers launch Melius AI platform
cards.body: Former Ramp engineers raised $20M to build Melius, pivoting from ad spend optimization to creative asset generation. The platform uses AI to automate campaign and content creation.

cards.title: Musubi releases PolicyLM for content moderation
cards.body: Musubi announced PolicyLM-1.7B, a lightweight AI decision model designed for real-time content moderation with open weights. The tool represents a new approach to automated platform safety.

cards.title: Lambda raises $4B ahead of 2027 IPO
cards.body: Nvidia-backed Lambda is securing up to $4B at a $14.5B pre-money valuation before its planned 2027 IPO. The funding was led by Coatue and Blackstone.

cards.title: AI agents face website access barriers
cards.body: Personal AI agents promise to book flights and make reservations, but anti-bot defenses block their access. A new standard aims to solve this friction between AI capabilities and website restrictions.

cards.title: Hark launches privacy-focused personal assistant
cards.body: Hark released a privacy-first personal AI assistant competing with Muse, Dots, and Instinct. The operating system is designed with privacy as a core feature.

cards.title: Mirror Particle builds human behavior prediction model
cards.body: Mirror Particle is launching at TechCrunch Disrupt with a world model predicting human behavior for market research. The company argues its approach surpasses LLM role-play for strategy applications.

cards.title: Anthropic offers free Claude Team year for startups
cards.body: Anthropic launched a program providing one free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits to startups. The company believes AI benefits reach consumers primarily through AI-powered startups.

cards.title: Microsoft debuts AI-friendly hardware and Windows changes
cards.body: Microsoft announced new hardware optimized for AI workloads alongside updates to Windows. The event showcases the company's push to integrate AI capabilities into consumer devices.

cards.title: Open source AI developer challenges Adobe with clones
cards.body: A bold AI developer is launching open source alternatives to Adobe's software. The move represents a shift toward accessible, AI-powered creative tools.

cards.title: Fraudster jailed for using AI bots to stream music
cards.body: A criminal was sentenced for operating 10,000 bots and AI-generated songs to manipulate streaming numbers. The case highlights AI's role in music fraud schemes.

cards.title: Mistral claims Le Chonk rivals best AI models
cards.body: Mistral announced "Le Chonk," a new AI model positioned to compete with leading models. The company continues its push for powerful open alternatives.

cards.title: Google launches improved SynthID AI content detector
cards.body: Google rolled out an upgraded version of SynthID, its AI-generated content detection tool, now available worldwide. The tool helps identify synthetic media created by AI models.

cards.title: AI/ML becomes performance factor in motorsport
cards.body: Machine learning is increasingly shaping competitive motorsport strategy and vehicle optimization. Teams now rely on AI systems for real-time performance analysis.

cards.title: OpenAI watermarks ChatGPT outputs in EU by default
cards.body: OpenAI will automatically add watermarks to ChatGPT-generated content for EU users. The feature aims to help identify AI-generated text and comply with regional regulations.
